mentions.name: Everyone Loses as a Service (ELaaS)
mentions.description: A satirical joke website presenting "Everyone Loses as a Service (ELaaS)", a parody SaaS business model that jokes about charging angry customers to prompt-hole tokens from companies' chatbots, selling those companies a monthly "protection" subscription to stop, auto-spamming newsletters via Google alerts on release notes, applying per-hour surge pricing against targeted companies, and staffing with interns and underpaid contractors — all so it can collect payments while doing nothing.
